home.lead: A private house in Tân Hưng (District 7), Ho Chi Minh City: three floors, three bedrooms that each have their own bathroom, an entertainment room for karaoke and movie nights, and a rooftop terrace that looks out over the river and the District 1 skyline.
hero: Rooftop terrace with river view and the District 1 skyline at ASCON LIVING, Ho Chi Minh City

sections.h2: A Saigon homestay with the whole house to yourselves
p: At ASCON LIVING you don't book a room. You book the whole house. Over 250 m² of living space across three floors plus a rooftop terrace, and every square metre of it is yours for the length of your stay. No reception desk, no shared hallways, no strangers at the breakfast table.

Each of the three bedrooms has its own bathroom and its own air conditioning, so nobody queues for the shower in the morning and everyone sleeps at the temperature they like. There is a guest WC next to the living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a large fridge, and a living room of about 40 m² with an L-shaped sofa and a 75-inch 4K TV.

Then there are the parts that make evenings at home worth staying in for. The entertainment room has karaoke, a 4K projector, a PlayStation with PlayStation Plus and Netflix. Up on the rooftop you can fire up the BBQ or the smoker while the lights of the District 1 skyline come on across the river.

Arriving is easy: self check-in with a keypad lock, a key for the outer gate, and an airport transfer you can arrange with your booking. WiFi of up to 1 Gbit/s with mesh on every floor keeps calls, streaming and remote work running smoothly. Whether you're a family, a group of friends or colleagues on a work trip, this Saigon homestay gives you the privacy of your own home with everything already in place.

house.title: Ho Chi Minh House Rental: 3 En-Suite Bedrooms | ASCON
house.description: Over 250 m² on three floors plus rooftop: 3 en-suite bedrooms, 40 m² living room, full kitchen, karaoke room with 4K projector. Ho Chi Minh City.
house.h1: The house: your Ho Chi Minh house rental, room by room
house.lead: Three floors, a rooftop terrace and over 250 m² of space that belong only to you. Here is what you'll find in every room, and what you can do there.

sections.h2: Living room: the heart of the house
p: The living room is where the day starts and where everyone ends up again in the evening. At about 40 m² it has room to spread out properly. The large L-shaped sofa seats the whole family or group at once, with space to put your feet up, and the 75-inch 4K TV makes it the natural place for a football match, a cartoon morning with the kids or a series everyone has been meaning to start. Netflix is ready to go.

After a hot day in the city, kick off your shoes, sink into the sofa and let someone put the kettle on in the kitchen. Plants and the glass doors keep the space light and relaxed rather than formal. It's a living room meant to be lived in: kids building a blanket fort on the sofa, friends planning tomorrow's route, someone curled up with a book in the corner.

A guest WC is right here in the living area, so visitors and kids don't have to climb the stairs to a bedroom bathroom. And with mesh WiFi of up to 1 Gbit/s, the living room also works as an easy place to answer a few emails or join a video call while the others are out exploring.

sections.h2: Kitchen and dining: cook like a local
p: Some of the best meals in Saigon start at the market. Bring back fresh herbs, mangoes and a bag of whatever smelled best at the street stall, and cook it your way in your own kitchen. It is fully equipped with a stove, an oven, a microwave, a rice cooker, a kettle and all the plates, bowls and cutlery you need.

The large fridge has enough room for a group's groceries, cold drinks for the rooftop and the marinated meat for tonight's BBQ. Families can prepare breakfast exactly the way the kids like it, keep snacks and milk on hand, and skip the daily search for a restaurant that suits everyone. Staying a week or longer? Having a proper kitchen makes a real difference to both comfort and budget.

The dining table by the kitchen windows brings everyone together for the moments that matter on a trip: a slow breakfast before a day out, a shared dinner, a late-night round of cards with a cold drink. And on the evenings when nobody wants to cook, restaurants and street food are close by.

sections.h2: Master bedroom: about 55 m² of calm
p: The master bedroom is a suite in its own right. At about 55 m² it is bigger than many city apartments, with a 180×200 cm bed that leaves plenty of room for two, its own air conditioning and its own private bathroom.

A 55-inch 4K TV lets you finish the evening with a film in bed, and the private balcony is the place for the first coffee of the morning before the rest of the house wakes up. There is a vanity corner for getting ready without rushing, and the house has a safe for passports and valuables, so you can head out without worrying.

It's an easy choice for parents who want a little retreat after a long day with the kids, for a couple celebrating something special, or for whoever organised the trip and has earned the best room. Fresh bedding, towels, toiletries and slippers are ready when you arrive, so all you need to do is unpack.
imgs: Master bedroom with 180×200 cm bed in the private house in Ho Chi Minh City

sections.h2: Bedroom 2: comfort with its own bathroom
p: Bedroom 2 is a comfortable, well-sized room with a 160×200 cm bed, its own air conditioning and its own bathroom. That en-suite bathroom matters more than it sounds: on a family holiday or a trip with friends, it means everyone has their own space, their own shower and their own schedule.

A smart TV with Netflix makes it easy to wind down at the end of the day, whether that's a cartoon for the kids before bedtime or a few episodes of something for the grown-ups. The art wall gives the room a warm, personal feel, more home than hotel.

Bedroom 2 suits a second couple, two siblings or grandparents who want a quiet room of their own while staying close to the rest of the family. Fresh bedding, towels and slippers are ready, hot water is always available, and an iron is on hand if you need to look sharp for a meeting or a dinner out.

sections.h2: Bedroom 3: quiet, dark and made for deep sleep
p: Bedroom 3 is the room for people who take their sleep seriously. It is quiet and naturally dark, so it stays restful even after sunrise. That makes it ideal for jet-lagged travellers who need to sleep in, light sleepers, kids who nap in the afternoon, or anyone who wants to recover properly after a big night of karaoke.
Like the other bedrooms, it has a 160×200 cm bed, its own air conditioning and its own private bathroom. A smart TV with Netflix is there for a quiet evening in.

Fresh bed linen and towels are laid out for you, along with toiletries and slippers. Close the door, set the AC to your favourite temperature and sleep through until you're ready for the day. When you wake up, the kitchen, the living room and the rooftop are only a staircase away.
imgs: Bedroom 3 with 160×200 cm bed, quiet and dark for a good night's sleep

p: No morning queue, no juggling who showers when. Each of the three bedrooms has its own private bathroom, and there is an extra guest WC in the living area. For families and groups, that alone can make the difference between a stressful morning and a relaxed one.

The bathrooms come with hot water, fresh towels and toiletries, so you can travel light and still feel looked after. The rain showers are the best way to rinse off a day of city heat and humidity before heading out again for dinner.

Because each bathroom belongs to one bedroom, everyone gets their own space to leave their things, get ready at their own pace and keep their routine, whether that's a toddler's bath time or a quick shower before a business meeting. Need fresh clothes for the rest of the trip? A laundry service is available on request.

sections.h2: Entertainment room: karaoke, movies and games
p: This is the room people talk about after the trip. The entertainment room turns an ordinary evening into the best night of the holiday, and you never have to leave the house.

Start with karaoke. Grab the microphones, dim the lights and let everyone pick a song, from the shy ones who need a duet partner to the ones who've been waiting all day for their big moment. When it's time to sit back, switch on the 4K projector for a movie night on the big screen: popcorn, the whole family on the sofas, and Netflix ready to stream.

For game nights there is a PlayStation with PlayStation Plus and two controllers, so you can play head-to-head racing, team up on a co-op adventure or run a family tournament where the kids beat the adults. It's an easy way for different generations to have fun together, and a perfect plan for a rainy afternoon.

If you've been looking for a private house with karaoke in Ho Chi Minh City, this is it, in a room of its own. Please keep in mind the house rule: loud music only until 21:30, which still leaves plenty of time for a proper session.

p: The top of the house is a rooftop terrace of about 56–60 m², and it's where many guests spend their favourite hours. By day, plants and an outdoor sofa make it a calm place to read or drink a coffee. As the sun goes down, the river and the District 1 skyline turn into the backdrop for dinner.

Light the BBQ or the smoker, set the table and watch the city lights come on while the food cooks. Solar lights add a warm glow once it's dark. It's the spot for a birthday dinner, a sundowner with friends or a quiet last evening before the flight home. Read more on the Rooftop & View page.

p: Arriving after a long flight should be simple, and it is. Check-in is self check-in with a keypad lock, so there is no waiting for someone to hand over keys and no stress if your flight lands late. You also receive a key for the outer gate. If you'd rather not deal with taxis at all, an airport transfer can be arranged together with your booking.

Inside, the entrance and staircase connect the three floors and lead all the way up to the rooftop terrace. A hallway leads to the bedroom doors, giving each room a little privacy from the shared spaces.

Your safety is taken seriously. Cameras are installed outdoors only, never inside the house, so your privacy stays intact. There is also a safe for valuables, and loud music only until 21:30 keeps things friendly with the neighbours.

p: ASCON LIVING works best for people who want to travel together without living on top of each other. Families get a private bathroom for every bedroom, a kitchen for easy meals and an entertainment room that keeps kids and teenagers happy. Groups of friends get karaoke, game nights and BBQ evenings on the rooftop. Colleagues on a work trip get fast mesh WiFi, quiet bedrooms and a living room that doubles as a meeting space.
If you're comparing Ho Chi Minh City vacation rentals, this is the difference: one private house, shared only with the people you came with. See our pages for families and for groups for more ideas.

rooftop.h1: Rooftop terrace with river and skyline view
rooftop.lead: About 56–60 m² at the top of the house, just for you: BBQ and smoker, an outdoor sofa, plants and a view across the river to the District 1 skyline.

sections.h2: Your private terrace above the city
p: Climb the stairs to the top of the house and the city opens up in front of you. The rooftop terrace is about 56–60 m² and belongs only to you and the people you're travelling with. Ahead lies the river, and beyond it the District 1 skyline, a view most hotel guests only see from a crowded rooftop bar.

During the day it's a green, relaxed corner of Saigon. Plants frame the space, the outdoor sofa invites you to stretch out with a coffee or a book, and kids can look out over the river and the city from above. It's a calm place to plan the day, catch up on messages or simply enjoy the fact that you have your own house with a view in Ho Chi Minh City.

When it's time to eat, the dining set seats everyone together. The BBQ and the smoker are right there, so the cook never has to miss the conversation. Shop for fresh seafood, skewers or vegetables at the market in the afternoon, store them in the large fridge downstairs, and you have the makings of the best dinner of your trip.

sections.h2: Evenings on the rooftop: BBQ with a skyline view
p: This is when the rooftop is at its best. As the sun sets, the sky over the river changes colour and the towers of District 1 light up one by one. Solar lights come on around the terrace and give the space a soft, warm glow without any effort.

Fire up the BBQ, or let something slow-cook in the smoker while everyone settles in on the outdoor sofa. Raise a glass to a birthday, a reunion or just a good day in the city. Friends can talk for hours here, and families can enjoy a relaxed dinner while the kids point out the lights of the skyline.
It also makes a lovely quiet spot for two once the others have gone to bed. Please keep the volume down from 21:30 out of respect for the neighbours; the view is just as good in a whisper.

families.title: Family Accommodation District 7, Saigon | ASCON LIVING
families.description: A whole private house for your family in District 7, Ho Chi Minh City: 3 bedrooms with own bathrooms, kitchen, movie room and rooftop with river view.
families.h1: Family accommodation District 7: a whole house for your family
families.lead: Travelling with kids, grandparents or the whole extended family? At ASCON LIVING you have the entire house to yourselves, with a bathroom for every bedroom and plenty of space to play, eat and rest.

sections.h2: Why families feel at home here
p: Family trips work best when everyone has room to breathe. In a hotel, that usually means two or three separate rooms, often on different floors, and a lot of time spent in corridors and lifts. At ASCON LIVING the whole family stays under one roof, in one private house with over 250 m² of living space across three floors plus a rooftop terrace.

There are three bedrooms, and each one has its own bathroom and its own air conditioning. Parents can take the master bedroom of about 55 m² with its 180×200 cm bed, balcony and 55-inch 4K TV. Bedrooms 2 and 3 each have a 160×200 cm bed and a smart TV, perfect for kids, teenagers or grandparents. Bedroom 3 is quiet and dark, which makes it ideal for afternoon naps and for little ones who wake up with the sun. A guest WC in the living area saves trips upstairs during the day.
No other guests share the house, so nobody minds if the kids are lively in the morning, and you never have to keep them quiet in a hallway.

sections.h2: Meals the way your family likes them
p: Picky eaters, early breakfasts, baby food, a craving for something familiar after a week of new flavours: a real kitchen solves all of that. The kitchen has a stove, an oven, a microwave, a rice cooker, a kettle and all the dishes you need, plus a large fridge for milk, fruit, snacks and drinks.

Cook a simple pasta for the kids and try something Vietnamese for yourselves, or bring back takeaway from the street food stalls and restaurants nearby and eat together at the dining table. On a warm evening, carry dinner up to the rooftop and grill on the BBQ with the river and the District 1 skyline in view.
imgs: Dining table by the kitchen windows for family meals
Fully equipped kitchen for families staying in District 7

sections.h2: Rainy afternoons and family movie nights
p: Every family holiday needs a plan B, and in Saigon's rainy season you'll be glad to have one. The entertainment room turns an afternoon indoors into a highlight: a movie night with the 4K projector and Netflix, a family karaoke contest, or a PlayStation tournament where the kids finally get to beat their parents. The living room with its L-shaped sofa and 75-inch 4K TV is the second place to gather for cartoons or a family film.
When the kids are asleep, the grown-ups can head up to the rooftop for a quiet drink under the solar lights. Loud music only until 21:30 means everyone gets a good night's sleep.
imgs: 4K projector screen for family movie nights in the entertainment room
75-inch 4K TV in the living room, set up for movie nights

p: Parents think about safety first, so here are the facts. Cameras are installed outdoors only, never inside. The house has a safe for passports and valuables, and self check-in with a keypad lock means you can arrive whenever your flight lands, with a separate key for the outer gate.

Travelling with luggage, car seats and tired kids is easier with a transfer, so an airport transfer can be arranged together with your booking. Fresh bedding, towels, toiletries, slippers and hot water are ready when you arrive, an iron is on hand, and a laundry service is available for longer stays.

It includes a Kids & family category with outings for children, places to eat close to the house, and practical help for getting around the city. sections.h2: Tân Hưng, District 7: local life on your doorstep
p: ASCON LIVING is at 389A Đường Trần Xuân Soạn in Tân Hưng ward, the area most people still call District 7 (Quận 7). Since the 2025 administrative reform the old district names are no longer official, but you'll hear "District 7" from drivers and locals every day, and it's the easiest way to describe where you are staying.

What you get here is everyday Saigon life rather than a tourist strip. Restaurants and street food are close to the house, so breakfast can be a fresh bánh mì or a steaming bowl of phở, and dinner can be whatever smells best on the walk home. On evenings in, it's easy to pick up food nearby and carry it up to the rooftop.

From the rooftop terrace you look across the river to the District 1 skyline, so the city centre always feels within reach, and at night you get the lights without the noise. Back at the house, loud music only until 21:30 keeps things relaxed for you and the neighbours.
For ideas on where to eat, what to see and how to get around, our ASCON Guide App lists places around the house with directions. You receive the password after booking.

sections.note: Travel times in Ho Chi Minh City depend heavily on traffic. Please allow extra time, especially at rush hour.
p: Arriving at Tân Sơn Nhất International Airport? The simplest option is our airport transfer, which you can arrange together with your booking. Your driver brings you straight to the gate, and with self check-in by keypad lock you can walk in whenever you arrive, even late at night. You also receive a key for the outer gate.

During your stay, ride-hailing apps and taxis are the easiest way to reach the city centre, markets and sights. If you'd like to explore further, the ASCON Guide App shows routes from the house to each place and practical tips for getting around Ho Chi Minh City. Exact arrival instructions are sent after booking.

faq.title: FAQ: Check-in, Rules & Services | ASCON LIVING
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about ASCON LIVING: check-in and check-out, self check-in, bedrooms and bathrooms, Wi-Fi, location, pets and laundry.

faq: How many bedrooms and bathrooms are there?
3 bedrooms with 3 beds (one 180×200 cm, two 160×200 cm). Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom and air conditioning, and there is an extra guest WC in the living area.
How fast is the Wi-Fi?

Fibre with up to 1 Gbit/s down and 300 Mbit/s up on the plan, with mesh Wi-Fi across all three floors. Actual speed depends on your device and network load; it is suitable for video calls, streaming, gaming and remote work.
How far is the city centre?
The city centre (former District 1) is easy to reach by ride-hailing app or taxi; travel time depends on traffic.
Is the house safe?
There are exterior cameras with motion detection (outdoors only, none inside the house), and entry is via smart lock.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is between 14:00 and 23:00, check-out is by 12:00.
How does check-in work?
Self check-in with a keypad. The outer gate uses a key; you receive the instructions after booking.
Is the whole house private?
Yes, you rent the entire house, including the rooftop terrace.
Do you offer airport transfer?
Yes, on request for 50 EUR.
Is there laundry?
There is a washing machine and an iron. A laundry service is available for 30 EUR per load.
Can we store luggage?
Yes, luggage storage is free.
Are pets allowed?
No, pets are not allowed.
Is smoking allowed?
Only in designated areas.
Which languages do the hosts speak?
German, English, Hindi, Punjabi, Urdu and Vietnamese.

guide.description: Our Ho Chi Minh City travel guide: the ASCON Guide App for guests, tips for travelling with kids and how to get from the airport to the house.
guide.h1: Ho Chi Minh City travel guide
guide.lead: Practical tips for your stay in Saigon, from the airport to the best places to eat, and our own guide app, made for ASCON LIVING guests.

p: Ho Chi Minh City is loud, delicious, fast and full of surprises, and the first day can feel like a lot. Our travel guide is here to make it easier. We've collected the questions guests ask us most: how to get from the airport to the house, what to do in Ho Chi Minh City with kids, where to eat near District 7 and how to get around the city without stress.

The heart of it is the ASCON Guide App, our own guest guide for the city. It's password-protected and made exclusively for ASCON LIVING guests: you receive the password after booking. Open it on your phone, and places to eat, cafés, sights, activities and practical help are all sorted around the house, with directions from your front door.

Start planning before you land, then use it every day of your stay. Whether it's your first trip to Vietnam or your fifth, a local guide in your pocket helps you spend less time searching and more time enjoying the city.

guide-app.title: ASCON Guide App: How to Get Around Ho Chi Minh City
guide-app.description: Our password-protected guest app for Ho Chi Minh City: places near the house, travel times, routes, a map and practical tips. Password after booking.
guide-app.h1: The ASCON Guide App: your Ho Chi Minh City guide in your pocket
guide-app.lead: A guest guide that opens in your phone's browser and shows you what's around the house and how to get there. Exclusive for ASCON LIVING guests; the password comes with your booking.

sections.h2: How to get around Ho Chi Minh City, made easy
p: New city, new language, a traffic system that seems to run on instinct: getting around Saigon can be the trickiest part of the trip. The ASCON Guide App takes care of it. Every place is listed with its distance from the house and estimated travel times, and one tap on Route gives you directions from your front door. The map shows everything around you at a glance, so you can see what's close and plan a day that makes sense.

Want lunch near a sight you're visiting, or a café on the way back? Open the map, pick a spot and go. It's like having a friend in the city who already knows the way, available any time, without data-hungry searches or endless review scrolling.
imgs: ASCON Guide App place card with distance, travel times and Route button
ASCON Guide App map of places around the house in Ho Chi Minh City

p: The app is organised into clear categories so you find what you need quickly: food, starting with our Top 10 near the house; cafés and desserts; bars and nightlife; kids and family; sights and culture; activities; relaxation; shopping; day trips; and practical and emergency information for arrival, getting around and the moments when you need help fast.
For families, the Kids & family category is a handy shortcut to outings with children. For groups, the food and nightlife sections make it easy to plan the evening.
imgs: ASCON Guide App food category with the Top 10 places near the house
ASCON Guide App practical and emergency information for Ho Chi Minh City
ul: Food – places to eat, starting with our Top 10, with opening hours and price notes.
Cafés & desserts – coffee and sweet stops for a break.
Bars & nightlife – ideas for an evening out.
Kids & family – outings with children.
Sights & culture – the city's landmarks and cultural highlights.
Activities – things to do in and around the city.
Relaxation – places to unwind.
Shopping – where to shop.
Day trips – excursions beyond the city.
Practical & emergency – arriving at Tân Sơn Nhất Airport, getting around, show-to-driver cards, common scams, plus an SOS button.

p: The app is available in English, German, Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Arabic. Add it to your home screen: once opened, it keeps its content on your phone, so it stays usable even with a weak connection. Handy for family travel in Vietnam, too: the Kids & family category collects outings with children. You receive the password after booking, so you can start planning before you even land.

groups.title: Whole House Rental Ho Chi Minh for Groups | ASCON LIVING
groups.description: Group accommodation in Saigon: a private house with 3 en-suite bedrooms, karaoke, 4K projector, PlayStation and a rooftop BBQ with skyline view.
groups.h1: Whole house rental Ho Chi Minh: group accommodation in Saigon
groups.lead: Friends' trip, family reunion or team getaway: ASCON LIVING gives your group a private house with three en-suite bedrooms, an entertainment room and a rooftop terrace for long evenings together.

sections.h2: One house, one group, no strangers
p: Travelling as a group is about the time you spend together, and that's hard when everyone is scattered across hotel rooms and corridors. At ASCON LIVING your group has the entire house: over 250 m² across three floors plus a rooftop terrace, shared with nobody but you.

Each of the three bedrooms has its own bathroom and its own air conditioning, so everyone keeps their privacy and their own routine. The master bedroom is about 55 m² with a 180×200 cm bed, a 55-inch 4K TV and a balcony. Bedrooms 2 and 3 have 160×200 cm beds and smart TVs. There's also a guest WC in the living area. Nobody fights over the bathroom, and nobody wakes the others when they head out early.

The shared spaces are made for being together. The living room of about 40 m² has a large L-shaped sofa and a 75-inch 4K TV, the kitchen is fully equipped, and the large fridge holds plenty of drinks for the evening. If you've been searching for a private house for groups in Ho Chi Minh City, this is a home with exactly that kind of space.

sections.h2: Karaoke nights, movie marathons and game tournaments
p: The entertainment room is your private party room. Start with karaoke: microphones in hand, lights down, and a playlist that only gets better as the evening goes on. Switch to the 4K projector for a movie marathon on the big screen with Netflix, or settle a long-running rivalry with a PlayStation tournament using PlayStation Plus.

No booking a karaoke room in town, no taxi home afterwards, no closing time but your own. Just remember the house rule: loud music only until 21:30, so plan the big numbers early and finish the night with a film.
imgs: Karaoke corner with ambient lighting for group nights
Karaoke microphones and remotes ready for a sing-along
PlayStation with two controllers for game nights

sections.h2: Rooftop BBQ with the District 1 skyline
p: The rooftop terrace of about 56–60 m² is where group trips become memories. Fire up the BBQ or the smoker, gather on the outdoor sofa and watch the lights of the District 1 skyline come on across the river. Celebrate a birthday, a bachelor or bachelorette weekend, a reunion with old friends or the end of a successful project. Solar lights keep the mood warm after dark.
imgs: Rooftop lounge in the evening, softly lit for a group night
BBQ grill on the rooftop terrace, ready for a skyline barbecue
River view towards the District 1 skyline from the house

sections.h2: For colleagues and work trips too
p: The house works just as well for business teams. WiFi of up to 1 Gbit/s with mesh on every floor handles video calls and uploads from any room. The living room and dining table double as a meeting space, the bedrooms are quiet, and an iron is ready before the client meeting. After work, the rooftop is a far better place to wind down than a hotel bar.

Self check-in with a keypad lock means your group can arrive at any time, with a key for the outer gate. Airport transfer can be arranged with your booking, which is handy when several people arrive with luggage. Fresh bedding, towels, toiletries, slippers and hot water are ready, and a laundry service is available. Cameras are outdoors only.

Restaurants and street food are close by for nights when nobody wants to cook, and the ASCON Guide App (password sent after booking) helps you find places to eat, bars and things to do across the city.
